title: Clean-Worktree and CI Lean 4 Reproduction Gate
statement: O6 — walked once in a clean worktree at 07185a6 (lake exe cache get + 17/17 PASS, VERIFICATION_RUN_007). Not yet demonstrated on a cold machine with empty host cache, and not yet a CI release gate.

verification.cold_machine_walk: PASS (VERIFICATION_RUN_008, 2026-09-07, commit d482823: fresh container, no pre-existing .lake/packages or Mathlib host cache, genuine network fetch; 32/32 targets, exit 0)
verification.ci_release_gate: PASS — lean-gate in .github/workflows/verify.yml runs verify_all_proofs.sh on push, schedule, and dispatch; 3/3 green including the cold scheduled run 2026-09-08T11:27Z; gate covered 39 targets at closure
verification.target_count: 39/39 PASS at closure (cold fetch + CI); gate has since grown to 43 targets (SU(2) envelope rungs, PR #39, 2026-09-09, independently verified at merge, CI lean-gate green on every push)

epistemic_boundary.closure_path: Demonstrate on a cold runner with empty ~/.cache/mathlib, pin lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json, and archive clean cold-runner execution logs.

closure.closed: 2026-09-08 per OPEN_PROBLEMS_AND_TESTS.md: cold-machine condition met by VERIFICATION_RUN_008; CI release-gate condition met by the lean-gate workflow (3/3 green incl. cold scheduled run). Honest claim: '39/39 targets pass from a cold fetch, gated in CI on every push' at closure; the gate now covers 43 targets, green in CI on every push.
closure.residual_caveat: The Mathlib prebuilt-cache endpoint is sometimes-cold-fetchable, not reliably so; the daily cron bounds the stall rate with data. Infrastructure-availability caveat, not an open reproduction question.
